payload.text: ISSUE:0001 until a devbin release carrying devbin#0326 is vendored into Cldr (bin/devbin and bin/.devbin/lib at that release). Then: the install: block (link set cldr: target/release/cldr, opt prefix ~/opt/cldr, config.toml from examples/config.toml), the contract's snippet word for word from devbin-cc so that --version prints T4's line, and the formula on @@INSTALL@@ with the pkgshare link. cldr gains no use, install, version or tree verb, ever (devbin-vc's ruling on hv's word).
